vehicle_level_1_has_no_parent.name: vehicle_level_1_has_no_parent
vehicle_level_1_has_no_parent.value: ("vehicle_classes"."level" = 1 AND "vehicle_classes"."parent_id" IS NULL) OR ("vehicle_classes"."level" = 2 AND "vehicle_classes"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

scores_in_range.name: scores_in_range
scores_in_range.value:
"retrospectives"."score_v" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "retrospectives"."score_r" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "retrospectives"."score_w" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "retrospectives"."score_t" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
          AND "retrospectives"."composite" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
